materialAndExposureLimits: At this distance and unchanged exposure, chair upholstery is dark and near-uniform; fabric weave, seam stitching and subtle roughness are not clearly resolved.

wholeOfficeLimits: The large room still has a broad empty floor and wall area relative to its two workstations; an occupied studio composition and practical room dressing are incomplete.
Books remain repeated colored rectangular blocks and the shelf remains generic; wall/ceiling and flat luminous fixture have limited construction detail.
The two viewpoints provide no resident activity, convincing workflow, other-room handcrafting, full East skyline or 220-building art acceptance.
